Anastasia is Talulah's official pair (it's the mat in the Talulah Starter Kits). Pink florals on a pink and aqua lattice, made for these tiles.
Britt Mills Viola's soft florals pick up both the blush and aqua layers. Stunning.
Heron's cranes on blush pink echo the cranes on Talulah's faces. Perfect pairing.

Virora's Parrotia is a beautiful pink and aqua match for Talulah.
Esme's teal garden with pink blooms is a natural Talulah match.

Oh My Mahjong's Isla mat also looks great with Willow, in fact I think if it were up to me I probably would have selected Isla as Willow's pair due to the coordination of the mustard-y gold layer to the pagoda accents, but both look amazing

Jade by Oh My Mahjong is my favorite of the latest OMM mat drop and is the true "pair" to Willow - meaning it's the mat that you get if you buy the starter kit bundles. You won't find Willow's exact green in Jade, but the beauty of Willow's

Same story on the soft peachy-pinks/coral of Mahj Tile Haus's White Lotus. You could pull those out with the MM sorbet racks or keep it earthy and beautiful with just about any of the other options. This mat is known to be hard to score but

Blue-toned mats are great with Solara because blue and orange are complimentary colors, opposite on the color wheel, and provide the maximum "pop" when placed against each other. Of the blues I picked, Oh My Mahjong's Jade is absolutely my

Amanda Toppe has multiple matches to Jade. Her Pink Winds mat pulls the blues & greens beautifully, much like it does with OMM Lagoon. And the blush pink/slightly lilac touches throughout pick up that center lilac layer perfectly.
The next 2 Amanda Toppe mats are very similar and both are fantastic matches for Jade, 1st up is Sparrow's nest. The tone of the Jade back and lilac middle layer match perfectly.
Tigre De Tartan's Garden Party is a colorful option that blends with many of Jade's tile faces. The green backs pop really nicely on this mat and bring out the bits of green in the mat as well.
Splash of Color's Hydrangea Blooms mat is a great match for Jade's back and lilac center as well as the blue and lilac tones of the faces.

Bespoke's Year Of The Dragon mat strikes again, this time in raspberry sorbet which does a beautiful job of picking up on the lilac tones of the faces while creating the perfect backdrop for those gorgeous jade backs to really pop.

Oh My Mahjong's Liberty mat is often tough to match but looks stunning with Malachite's coordination to its greens, reds and cobalt blues. Love this one especially with oak racks.
